info.title: HSK Automation API
info.description:
Housekeeping automation API for Novotel and ibis budget Münster City.

**Authentication:** sign in via `POST /auth/login`. The session cookie is then sent automatically with each request.

**Conventions:** hotel `1` = ibis budget, `2` = Novotel · dates `YYYY-MM-DD` · times in UTC · errors return `{ "error": "…" }`.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Task-sheet upload, processing and marked PDFs

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Daily and monthly reports and email delivery

get.description: Returns `ok` when the API and database are reachable, otherwise `unavailable` (503).

post.description: Verifies the username and password and starts a session by setting the `hsk_session` cookie.
Ends the current session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user and role. Use it to check whether the session is still valid.
Returns the 100 most recent task-sheet runs with their status and per-hotel results.

files.description: The Novotel and ibis task sheet PDFs (max 20 MB each)

post.description: Uploads the daily Novotel and ibis task-sheet PDFs and starts processing in the background. Track progress with `GET /runs/{id}`.

get.description: Returns a run's progress, validation warnings and the assigned colour of every room.
Returns the hotel's report followed by the original task sheet with a coloured marker next to each room.
Returns the active cleaning rhythm and any scheduled change for each hotel.

post.description: Sets or schedules a hotel's cleaning rhythm from a given date. Director only.

delete.description: Cancels a planned rhythm change before it takes effect. Director only.

get.description: Lists all rhythm changes and cancellations, with who made them and when.
Returns billing, workload, room-check and daily-close figures for a day, week or month, for one or both hotels.
Returns all staff members with their hotel, company, role and monthly check limit.

post.description: Adds a cleaner or supervisor. Director only.

put.description: Edits or deactivates a staff member. Director only.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Only moves with this move or cleaning date. Omit for all.

get.description: Returns guest room moves (latest 500), optionally only those moved or cleaned on a given date.

post.description: Records a guest moving to another room. The vacated room is cleaned today, or the next morning if no cleaner is available.

get.description: Returns the room checks of a day, daily totals per hotel and the month's usage against the check limits.

post.description: Records rooms inspected by a supervisor, either as a list of rooms or as a count.

delete.description: Removes a room-check entry and returns the updated overview.

get.description: Returns every day of a month with its close status, room totals and whether reports were emailed.
Returns the end-of-day record for a date: staff hours, cleaned rooms, calculated totals and open issues.

put.description: Saves the end-of-day entries without locking the day.

post.description: Saves and locks the day, then emails the daily reports. A failed email does not undo the lock.
Unlocks a confirmed day so it can be edited again. Director only.

get.description: Returns the daily task-sheet or handover PDF for one hotel.

post.description: Sends the day's reports to the configured recipients.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Any date of the week; `2026-11-02.pdf` returns the PDF

get.description: Returns the Monday–Sunday Wochenbericht for the week containing the date, as JSON or as a PDF when the date ends in `.pdf`. Sent automatically on Monday 10:00 for the week before, when at least one day is confirmed.

post.description: Sends the week's Wochenbericht to the WEEKLY recipients.

get.description: Returns the month's service statement (Leistungsnachweis) as JSON, or as a PDF when the month ends in `.pdf`.

post.description: Sends the month's service statement to the configured recipients.

get.description: Returns the 100 most recent report emails and their delivery status.
Returns the property details, prices and email recipients.

put.description: Saves the property details, prices and email recipients. Director only.

Download.name: download
Download.description: Present = download as attachment instead of inline

Recipients.description: Email addresses per report kind. A kind left out of a save keeps its saved addresses; an empty list clears it.

emailTransport.description: Read-only. `azure` and `smtp` send live; `outbox` only saves a local copy.

WeeklyBilling.description: Monday–Sunday check billing of one hotel; only confirmed days of the selected month count. Negative balances are kept.

MonthlyStatement.description: Leistungsnachweis data. Monthly `zuBerechnen` totals are the sum of the weekly ledger.

WeeklyReport.description: Wochenbericht: Monday–Sunday, both hotels. Days that are not confirmed have empty cells.
